name: BIPBIP14_ST_EAT
meaning: SetState 0: anim EAT at startPos, route follower initialised; Update: -> 1 when the Wolf is within ~1200 (inferred)

name: BIPBIP14_ST_START
meaning: SetState 1: anim START; Update: on anim end -> 2 (inferred)

name: BIPBIP14_ST_RUN
meaning: SetState 2: anim RUN1 + sound 0x136; Update: runs, stops at a shut FallingGate (3) (inferred)

name: BIPBIP14_ST_RUN_ROUTE
meaning: SetState 3: anim RUN1 + sound 0x136; Update: follows gotoFollower, -> 6 when the Wolf is close and no gate is shut (inferred)

name: BIPBIP14_ST_WAIT
meaning: SetState 4: anim STAND; Update: waits waitLeftMs then goes to stateAfterWait (inferred)

name: BIPBIP14_ST_STOP_AT_STATION
meaning: SetState 5: anim STOP2; Update: sets chased, -> 1 when the train station reports no train in the zone (inferred)

name: BIPBIP14_ST_STAND_WATCH
meaning: SetState 6: sound stopped, anim STAND; Update: -> 1 near, -> 3 far (inferred)

name: BIPBIP14_ST_RETURN
meaning: SetState 7: anim RUN1; Update: follows returnFollower back to startPos, then 0 (inferred)
